VoucherDefinition.name: VoucherDefinition
VoucherDefinition.description: Represents details about a voucher definition that’s used to issue vouchers.

AutogeneratedCodeLength.description: The length of the auto-generated code of vouchers issued by the definition. If no value is specified, the default is eight digits. This field is available in API version 57.0 and later.

CodePrefix.description: The prefix of the auto-generated code of vouchers issued by the definition. This field is available in API version 57.0 and later.

CodeSuffix.description: The suffix of the auto-generated code of vouchers issued by the definition. This field is available in API version 57.0 and later.

CostPerVoucher.description: The liability incurred for each voucher issued by the voucher definition. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

Description.description: The description of the voucher definition.

DiscountPercent.description: The discount percentage of the voucher definition.

EffectiveDate.description: Required. The date on which the vouchers issued by the voucher definition become valid.

EffectiveDateTime.description: The date and time from when the vouchers issued by the voucher definition can be redeemed. This field is available in API version 62.0 and later.

ExpirationDate.description: The date on which the vouchers issued by the voucher definition are no longer available for customers to redeem. The expiration date is only valid for the fixed date model.

ExpirationDateTime.description: The date and time on which the vouchers issued by the voucher definition are no longer available for customers to redeem. This field is available in API version 62.0 and later.

ExpirationPeriod.description: The number of days or months in the expiration period.

ExpirationPeriodUnit.description: Specifies the unit for the expiration period.

ExpirationType.description: Required. Specifies the expiration model of the vouchers issued by the definition.

FaceValue.description: The value of the vouchers issued by the voucher definition.

HasTimeBasedVoucherPeriod.description: Indicates whether vouchers issued by using the definition are effective and expire at a specific date and time. This field is available in API version 62.0 and later.

ImageUrl.description: The URL for the voucher definition image. This field is available in API version 57.0 and later.

IsActive.description: Required. Indicates whether the voucher definition is active (true) or not (false).

IsPartialRedeemable.description: Indicates whether the vouchers issued by the definition can be partially redeemed (true) or not (false). This field is available in API version 53.0 and later.

LastReferencedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user referenced this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The most recent date on which a user viewed this record.

LoyaltyProgramId.description: The ID of the loyalty program associated with the voucher definition.

Name.description: The name of the voucher definition.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who owns this record.

PartnerAccountId.description: The partner associated with the voucher definition.

ProductCategoryDerivedFieldId.description: A look up to show product category in voucher definition.

ProductDerivedFieldId.description: A look up to show product in voucher definition.

ProductId.description: The product associated with the voucher definition.

Type.description: Required. The type of voucher definition.
